decisions.reason: Polymer concrete drain housings are a core component of the firm's compatible drainage families and were given their own page, so they fit its main direction.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the firm's strategy of accessible, low-profile bathroom solutions.
The designer shower drain is presented as the flagship of the firm's design-focused direction, so dropping it after one year is very unlikely.
A shower element with integrated slope supports integrated, easy-to-install floor-level showers, though it is only mentioned on the website and is less established.
The DallSafe backflow-protected basement drain has its own page and a specific launch message, and it addresses a durable niche need in a sanitary manufacturer's long-cycle range.
The air-admittance valve is a peripheral but low-cost complementary item that rounds out the installer range, so keeping it is likely even though it is not a focus.
